osaka_sushi_yoshi_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a sweet soy sauce goes on the nigiri (April 2026), and there is grilled anago and red miso soup, so ask about soy sauce and glazes when booking.
osaka_sushi_yoshi_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-shellfish sushi course with foie gras, sea urchin and a dashi-based small dish.
osaka_sushi_yoshi_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 12:00–13:30 (last order 13:00) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sunday, public holidays and the days before and after a public holiday, also Mondays that fall on a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations taken, same day too, even 5 minutes ahead by phone; let the landline ring a while; bookings from phone numbers other than Japanese mobiles may not be confirmed and can be cancelled (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 6 counter seats; non-smoking; coin parking next door (Tabelog). Menus in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese and Korean; staff speaking English, Chinese and Korean (Tabelog). One person runs lunch (June 2025 review). Opened here 2 April 2014 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_yoshi_minamisenba.notes: [Sushi · Minami-Senba, a six-seat counter known for foie gras and mozzarella nigiri] A calm, wood-toned counter of six seats in a quiet Minami-Senba alley that calls its sushi 'gourmet nigiri': Edomae classics such as lean tuna, kombu-cured anago and a kanpyo roll sit beside foie gras seared on the surface, mozzarella, and water eggplant with sea urchin. The tamago is filled with foie gras, squid and shrimp. Lunch is 10 pieces for ¥5,000 or a ¥12,500 omakase, served quickly by one person; dinner is a course. The pieces are small, and one April 2026 diner found the sweet soy glaze too strong; a long-time fan returns for the foie gras and mozzarella nigiri. A July 2022 diner who had eaten at Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi some 20 years earlier found much the same menu here. Book by phone, from a Japanese mobile number if possible.

chef_bio.background: Opened at this address on 2 April 2014 (Tabelog). A July 2022 diner had eaten at Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi about 20 years earlier and found the menu here mostly the same, foie gras sushi included. One person runs the counter at lunch (June 2025 review); diners describe a friendly chef with entertaining stories (2020 and 2022 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Creative toppings alongside Edomae-style classics (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras nigiri; mozzarella nigiri; eggplant with sea urchin.

anecdotes.text: "The egg was quite elaborate, filled with foie gras, squid, and shrimp, which is a bit different from the traditional Edo-style shrimp and white fish paste." — April 2026, Gourmet Nigiri (10 pieces) ¥5,000.

"I used to go to Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi 20 years ago… The menu was mostly the same as the one in Tsuruhashi, and I was so happy to enjoy my favorite foie gras sushi after a long time." — July 2022.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿し吉、大阪市中央区南船場2-9-3、クリスタ長堀の北4・北5出口から北へ徒歩3分ほど (長堀橋駅・心斎橋駅)、本町駅・堺筋本町駅から徒歩6分、月〜土12:00〜13:30 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、日祝・祝前日・祝後日休み、月曜祝日も休み、予約可 (当日5分前でも電話で)、日本の携帯電話以外の番号からの予約は確認できないことがある、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、6席 (カウンター)、禁煙、隣にコインパーキング、英語・中国語 (繁体・簡体)・韓国語のメニュー、英語・中国語・韓国語のスタッフ、オープン日2014年4月2日、Instagram (minamisenba_sushiyoshi)。口コミ(2018年〜2026年9月): 創作寿司、昼は握り10貫5000円 (英語の口コミでは Gourmet Nigiri)かおまかせ12500円 (2026年4月)、夜のコースは12000円と16000円 (2024年2月)、フォアグラの握り、モッツァレラの握り、水茄子や焼き茄子にウニ、甘エビの肝ソース、Senshu のイカと赤酢のシャリ、昆布締めの穴子、赤身、トロ、アジ、焼き穴子、かんぴょう巻き、フォアグラ・イカ・エビ入りの玉子、セコガニ、ウニの茶碗蒸し、赤だし、昼は一人で営業 (2025年6月)、話の楽しい気さくな大将、甘い醤油だれが強すぎるという声、握りは小ぶり、20年前に Tsuruhashi の寿し吉に通った人によると品書きはほぼ同じ (2022年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Bookings from non-Japanese phone numbers may not be confirmed (Tabelog).

osaka_bistro_umami_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the menu runs from bread, pita, couscous, fresh pasta and fritters to grilled meats, bouillabaisse and dips, and the shop asks about dislikes before a course (December 2025), so raise gluten then.
osaka_bistro_umami_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly seafood and meat, but the meze include hummus, a roasted-eggplant dip, a red pepper and walnut paste (which contains breadcrumbs) and ratatouille; no vegan statement, so ask.
osaka_bistro_umami_shinmachi.hours_raw: Official site (October 2026): lunch 11:30–14:30 (Sat, Sun and holidays from 12:00); dinner 17:30–22:00 (Fri, Sat and days before holidays to 24:00); irregular closing days, posted monthly — November 2026: 3, 10, 15, 18, 23 and 30 November. Tabelog lists no lunch on Tuesday and Thursday, dinner to 23:00 on most nights, and closures on the 2nd and 3rd Sundays and public holidays; the hours here follow the site's times and Tabelog's lunch days. Lunch changed in October 2026 from reservation-only to walk-ins welcome (official site); the lunch course still needs a booking. One-drink minimum at dinner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), iD, QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter, 6 at tables; a table booking may still be seated at the counter; non-smoking; school-age children welcome, no strollers (Tabelog). English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 29 July 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_bistro_umami_shinmachi.notes: [Mediterranean bistro · Shinmachi near Yotsubashi, Middle Eastern meze from a one-person kitchen] A small Santorini-themed bistro on the south side of a Shinmachi apartment block, run by one owner-chef whom reviewers credit with cooking in Dubai and London. Start with the appetizer platter — hummus, orange-marinated beets, tapenade, a carpaccio, sometimes a smoky roasted-eggplant dip or an Aleppo-style red pepper and walnut paste — then the seafood bouillabaisse, saving the broth for the risotto that reviewers insist on. Lamb brochettes over spicy couscous are the official No. 1; the red-wine-braised beef cheek is said to take three days. Since spring 2026 lunch is a pita sandwich set with lentil soup, harissa and tzatziki from about ¥1,000. The wine list leans unusual. Diners call the owner cheerful and willing to talk food at the counter; the room was featured in an・an and Meets, per an October 2025 review. One cook means relaxed pacing, and the counter passage is narrow.

roles: Owner-chef (runs the bistro alone, per a November 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 29 July 2024 (Tabelog). The owner, described on the official site as having wide experience, cooks the food and picks the wines (official site; Tabelog). Reviewers say the chef cooked for the wealthy in places like Dubai and London (October 2025 review) and worked in Dubai and London (July 2026 review), and a July 2024 diner had followed the chef from a previous restaurant. Featured in an・an and in Meets' "Delicious Book 2026" (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Making Mediterranean cuisine more familiar": Mediterranean cooking that spreads out from the south of France, with fresh seafood, game and vegetables, and unusual wines (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Mediterranean appetizer platter; seafood bouillabaisse and risotto; lamb brochette.

anecdotes.text: "It's incredible that I can enjoy dishes from a chef who has cooked for the wealthy in places like Dubai and London at such reasonable prices in Nishihonmachi!" — October 2025, second visit.
"Despite being run by a single person, the timing of the food delivery was just right, and everything was served hot and fresh." — November 2025, course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (bistro-umami.com): 「地中海料理をもっと身近に」、南フランスから広がる地中海料理と厳選ワイン、サントリーニ島をイメージした店、新鮮な魚介やジビエ、野菜、多彩な経験を持つ店主が料理を用意、気さくな店主、四ツ橋駅から徒歩4分、営業11:30〜14:30 (土日祝12:00〜)・17:30〜22:00 (金土祝前日〜24:00)、不定休 (11月は3・10・15・18・23・30日)、ランチは2026年10月から予約なしでも可、ランチコースは要予約、地中海オードブル2名盛2860円、仔羊のブロシェットとスパイシークスクス580円 (人気No.1)、魚介山盛りブイヤベース1980円、UMaランチコース3080円、コース5000円〜7700円、パスタは淡路の製麺所の生パスタ、ワインはグラス680円から。食べログ: 大阪市西区新町1-22-22 新町ダイヤパレス 104 (建物の南側)、西大橋駅・四ツ橋駅から徒歩4分、14席 (カウンター8、テーブル6)、禁煙、ワンドリンク制、カード・iD・QUICPay可、英語のスタッフ、オープン日2024年7月29日。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年10月): 店主ひとりで営業、Dubai や London で経験を積んだシェフ、前の店からのファン、an・an と Meets に掲載、地中海前菜の盛り合わせ (フムス、ビーツのオレンジマリネ、焼き茄子のペースト、アレッポ発祥の赤パプリカとくるみのペースト)、ブイヤベースと〆のリゾット、牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮込みは3日かける、ブリワット、2026年春からピタサンドのランチ (チキン、ラム、季節の具、レンズ豆のスープ、ポテト、ハリッサ、ザジキ)、珍しいワイン、明るい店主、カウンターの後ろの通路はせまい。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); dislikes are asked before a course (December 2025).

osaka_chinese_yin_yang_hakuromachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dumplings, shumai, spring rolls, noodle soups and crêpe-wrapped char siu are wheat, and the sauces (black bean, soy-garlic, chili) are not described; nothing is marked gluten-free.
osaka_chinese_yin_yang_hakuromachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an à la carte Chinese menu built on pork, chicken, shrimp, squid and fish; no vegan dishes are described.
osaka_chinese_yin_yang_hakuromachi.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30; Mon and Sat 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:50); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch cannot be reserved and is paid in cash or PayPay only; dinner reservations taken, two people usually seated at the counter or a table for two (Tabelog). One drink per person at dinner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, Rakuten Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: 7 at the counter, 10 at tables (Tabelog details); the shop text says 6 counter seats, one table for 2 and two tables for 4. Non-smoking; English menu; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of the 8R Bldg, reached by stairs at the back of the building (January 2025 review). Opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_chinese_yin_yang_hakuromachi.notes: [Chinese · Hakuromachi, a white, stylish room up the back stairs behind the W Osaka] Easy to miss: climb the stairs at the back of an older, well-renovated building and the second floor opens into a bright, modern room with a counter and tables. A January 2025 reviewer called it the second shop of Tokuchaina, and a September 2026 diner who usually goes to Tokuchaina came here for the first time. The cooking is Cantonese-leaning and gently seasoned, with market fish and seasonal vegetables: start with the assorted appetizer platter, then the mapo tofu sharpened with fermented black beans, a fresh-fish carpaccio, stir-fried squid with black beans, shrimp chili or the tom yum fried rice, and finish with a green-onion and char siu noodle soup. Natural wines and Shaoxing run alongside. Weekday lunch is a few sets (mapo tofu, yurinchi, shrimp chili and a weekly special); an April 2026 diner had the special soy-sauce noodles with four small sides for ¥1,200. Dishes come out at a leisurely pace, so order most of it at once.

chef_bio.background: Chinese restaurant opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog). A January 2025 review calls it the second shop of Tokuchaina; a September 2026 reviewer usually eats at Tokuchaina.
chef_bio.philosophy: Cantonese-inspired dishes with light seasoning, made from fresh domestic fish and seasonal vegetables bought at the market, paired with natural wine and Shaoxing wine (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; assorted appetizers; Cantonese-style fresh-fish carpaccio.

anecdotes.text: "I was pleasantly surprised by the lavishness of the side dishes for lunch! Century egg tofu, pickled mustard greens, menma, and pickles … I think it's a great deal to have such a luxurious lunch for just JPY 1200." — April 2026, weekly special Chinese noodles.
"The Char Siu Wrapped in Crepe was inspired by Peking Duck. The rich sauce was delicious, and the chewy crepe combined with chunky char siu made for a hearty dish." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中国菜 Yin Yang、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-14 8Rビル 2F、心斎橋駅から徒歩4分、火〜金11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:30、月・土17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 21:50)、日曜休み、ランチは予約不可で現金とPayPayのみ、お一人様ワンドリンク制、カード・PayPay・楽天ペイ可、17席 (カウンター7、テーブル10)、禁煙、英語メニューあり、オープン日2024年4月6日。店の紹介: 広東の要素を取り入れたやさしい味の中国料理、市場で仕入れる国産の鮮魚と季節の野菜、自然派ワインと紹興酒、人気は前菜盛り合わせ、麻婆豆腐、トムヤム炒飯、広東風の鮮魚のカルパッチョ。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年10月): Tokuchaina の2号店、W Osaka の裏のビルの奥の階段を上った2階、白を基調にしたおしゃれな店内、前菜5種盛り、豆豉の効いた麻婆豆腐、イカと豆豉炒め、黒酢酢豚、海老チリ、エビマヨ、油淋鶏、海老餃子、鶏とクワイの焼売、牡蠣焼売、チャーシューのクレープ包み、春巻き、ネギとチャーシューのスープ麺、杏仁豆腐、ランチは週替わりの中華そばと小鉢4品で1200円、料理はゆっくり出てくる。

osaka_yakiniku_nikutoieba_matsuda_hakuro.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the truffle yukke comes with egg-yolk soy sauce, and the menu also has a katsu sandwich, croquettes, pasta and a sansho-miso hot pot that ends in ramen, so ask about marinades and sauces for the grilled cuts.
osaka_yakiniku_nikutoieba_matsuda_hakuro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant.
osaka_yakiniku_nikutoieba_matsuda_hakuro.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Wednesday and the 1st and 3rd Thursdays (Tabelog). Reservations taken, online booking via Tabelog; one October 2026 table had a 2-hour limit because of a later booking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR payment (Tabelog). 16 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 6; whole shop for up to 20; non-smoking; sommelier on staff; menu in English and Chinese (Tabelog). Opened 30 August 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_yakiniku_nikutoieba_matsuda_hakuro.notes: [Yakiniku · Hakuromachi, the Osaka counter of a Nara wagyu shop] The Osaka sister of Niku to Ieba Matsuda in Nara, behind a hidden-feeling entrance: a tea-room-like room with a tokonoma-style backdrop, bamboo and a pine-tree neon sign, and a long full-flat counter where the cooking happens in front of you. Yamato beef from Nara is the point. The signature is the thick-cut Chateaubriand tongue, sliced and grilled at the counter; diners also order the Chateaubriand, outside skirt, the truffle yukke and the beef sashimi, and finish with garlic fried rice studded with Chateaubriand. The kitchen also cooks pasta, beef stew, tacos and a katsu sandwich, and a sommelier pours from over 100 wines. Omakase courses run ¥6,000 or ¥11,000. Several October 2026 diners found the service slow on busy nights; one table had a two-hour limit.

chef_bio.background: Osaka sister shop of Niku to Ieba Matsuda in Nara (Tabelog, shop-provided); opened 30 August 2022 (Tabelog). Tabelog links the website trio-inc.jp, a TRIO Inc. page that was under maintenance on 30 October 2026. A September 2026 reviewer calls the Nara shop the original.
chef_bio.philosophy: Yamato beef grilled cut by cut with matching seasonings, alongside genre-crossing dishes from experienced chefs and sommelier-chosen wines (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Chateaubriand tongue; wagyu truffle yukke; Chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: "Watching the tongue being expertly sliced right in front of me and then grilled to perfection with just the right heat was an incredible experience." — September 2026, signature Chateaubriand tongue.
"I had garlic fried rice topped with small pieces of Chateaubriand, and it was fantastic!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: #にくといえばまつだ 大阪店、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-14 1F、心斎橋駅3番出口から北へ徒歩5分、本町駅13番出口から南へ徒歩7分、月火木〜日・祝17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、水曜と第1・第3木曜休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、16席 (カウンター10、個室6)、禁煙、ソムリエあり、英語・中国語メニューあり、オープン日2022年8月30日。店の紹介: 奈良の「にくといえばまつだ」の姉妹店、奈良のブランド牛 Yamato beef、和牛のトリュフユッケ、牛タンのシャトーブリアン、パスタ、ビーフシチュー、タコスなどの創作料理、ソムリエが選ぶ100種以上のワイン、茶室のような和モダンの空間とフルフラットのカウンター、個室あり、おまかせコース6000円・11000円、個室限定の和牛の山椒鍋コース8500円。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 目の前で切って焼くシャトーブリアンタン、ハラミ、サーロイン、赤身、牛刺し、キムチ、ハンバーグ、カツサンド、シャトーブリアン入りのガーリックライス、コロッケ、水出しの Yamato tea、提供が遅いという声がいくつか、次の予約で2時間制のことも。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book online; counter grilling (2026).

osaka_chinese_azuki_minamisenba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: xiaolongbao, gyoza, shumai, spring rolls, dan dan noodles, champon and Shanghai yakisoba are wheat, and the sauces (black vinegar, soy-based yurinchi dressing) are not described; nothing is marked gluten-free.
osaka_chinese_azuki_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an à la carte Chinese menu of pork, chicken, beef, shrimp and squid dishes; no vegan dishes are described.
osaka_chinese_azuki_minamisenba.hours_raw: Official site: 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sunday and public holidays. Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:30, Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Sunday, public holidays and the 1st and 3rd Saturdays. A September 2026 diner says the shop opens every other Saturday. Reservations by phone or on Tabelog, recommended for the evening; lunch draws a queue (April 2026 review). Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 14 seats, seven tables for two; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair access; children welcome; take-out and delivery; English and Chinese menu with photos (Tabelog). Opened 7 January 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_chinese_azuki_minamisenba.notes: [Chinese · Minamisenba, a small Chinese bar-diner run by a warm couple] Chinese restaurant, bar and diner in one, as one diner puts it: fourteen seats at two-person tables near Nagahoribashi, opened in January 2025. A March 2026 regular credits a husband-and-wife team with the warm, attentive service; another diner was greeted by the friendly woman serving with thanks for an earlier group visit, and says Google suggests 'Azuki Oneesan' when you search the shop. Repeat diners come back for the sweet Shanghai yakisoba, piping-hot xiaolongbao with black vinegar, crisp gyoza, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork and a surprisingly good potato salad with apple; the yurinchi reportedly draws a lunch queue. Lunch is three fixed sets plus a daily special (seafood champon ¥1,200 in February 2026, a mapo curry in April). Courses with all-you-can-drink suit groups, and the whole room can be booked for 20.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2025 (Tabelog). Described by a March 2026 regular as run by a husband-and-wife team; a November 2025 diner was seen off at the door by the manager.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese at reasonable prices, with dishes that suit drinks (official site and Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Spicy mapo tofu; yurinchi; Shanghai yakisoba; xiaolongbao.

anecdotes.text: "Additionally, the warm and attentive service from the husband-and-wife team is another charm of this place, making it a very comfortable dining experience." — March 2026, third visit.
"There's always a very friendly lady serving, and she remembered me, saying, 'Thank you for visiting us with your group the other day.' I was quite touched." — April 2026, mapo curry lunch special.

osaka_tempura_tenjin_hakuromachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: everything is wheat-batter tempura, and the tentsuyu is cut with a soy-sauce kaeshi (official site). Moshio sea salt is offered as an alternative dip, but the batter itself is wheat.
osaka_tempura_tenjin_hakuromachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the tentsuyu is made with dashi from kombu and bonito, mackerel and sardine flakes (official site), and vegetables share the fryer with shrimp, fish and chicken. A vegetable set (six vegetables and an onion-and-corn kakiage) exists.
osaka_tempura_tenjin_hakuromachi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog and the official site's top page); the operator's shop page gives 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00) and irregular closing days, and an August 2026 regular says the shop closes early in the evening. Open Sundays, holidays, Obon and Golden Week; closed over New Year; ad hoc closures announced on Facebook and Instagram (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), transport IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no service or cover charge (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 12 at tables (Tabelog; the official site says 18). Non-smoking, smoking area by the entrance; children welcome, step at the entrance; menu in English, Chinese and Korean with photos (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (Tabelog); courses from two people, one free drink each when booked by phone (official site), though the site's contact box also says no reservations.
osaka_tempura_tenjin_hakuromachi.notes: [Tempura · Hakuromachi, Hakata-style everyday tempura between Honmachi and Shinsaibashi] The name joins Tenjin, the Fukuoka district known for its crowd of casual tempura shops, with 'the god of tempura' (official site). Tempura is fried in 100% rice oil and brought to you a few pieces at a time, so it arrives piping hot: lunch is a set with rice that is cooked continuously in small cookers and refilled free (white or barley), miso soup and homemade daikon pickles on the table. The favourite is the Tamago set, whose soft-boiled egg tempura goes over the rice; others go for 'angel shrimp' (from New Caledonia, one regular heard), kisu, sardines, cheese-stuffed chikuwa or a dorayaki tempura with butter. In the evening, ¥1,000 buys a beer with shrimp, eggplant and chicken tempura. The shop is the only restaurant of Patria Co., whose site names the manager as Takimoto Youhei, from Hokkaido; an August 2026 regular noticed new staff and a new potato salad.

chef_bio.background: Named as manager of the shop on the site of Patria Co., which runs it as its only restaurant from the same address; the site describes a manager who is earnest and passionate rather than high-energy, answers customers' requests in the tempura, and trains the frying staff in a spirit of "no waste, precise". The site is undated, and an August 2026 regular noticed the staff had changed recently. Patria's representative director, 冨安 美絵子 (Tomiyasu Mieko), is from Fukuoka, studied at Saga University aiming to teach art, went into martial arts as a student and after graduating, and founded the company after retiring (operator's site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshly fried tempura served straight from the fryer in front of the diner, to make tempura casual and familiar (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tamago tempura set (soft-boiled egg tempura); angel shrimp.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the popular Tamago Tempura (JPY 1350). The shrimp was plump and juicy, and the eggplant was crispy. I enjoyed the Tamago Tempura on top of my rice, and it was delicious when mixed with the tempura scraps." — September 2026.
"You can get three pieces of freshly fried tempura (chicken tempura, eggplant tempura, and shrimp tempura) along with a bottle of beer for just JPY 1000!" — August 2026, a regular of a few years.
